evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.limitation: The golden scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' does not exist anywhere under data/ (grep for the id returns nothing; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json holds a different corpus). The scenario's champions, levels, target armor and event ledger are therefore NOT recoverable from the permitted evidence tree. The computation below is consequently a RATIO oracle: it identifies, from the cached wiki text alone, which sourced multiplier can and cannot produce the observed 94.1 -> 101.7 move, and rules the alternatives out numerically.

step_1_observed_ratio.rounding_band: Golden leaves are stored to 1 decimal. True old in [94.05, 94.15), true new in [101.65, 101.75) => the true multiplicative ratio lies in [1.0796602, 1.0818712].
step_1_observed_ratio.note: Any candidate mechanism must produce a multiplier inside that band.

1.08_Bloodsong_melee_branch.implied_new: 94.1 x 1.08 = 101.628; consistent with a stored 101.7 whenever the unrounded old value is >= 94.1204, which lies inside the 94.1 bin

step_2_candidate_multipliers_from_cached.conclusion: Exactly one sourced percentage amplifier in the cache lands in the band: +8%.

step_3_rule_out_black_cleaver_as_the_cau.why_tested: The scenario is named for Black Cleaver, and docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 2.3 flags the BC average-stack model (constant 0.8 x max_stacks) as an approximation with a recommended replacement by the exact Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h).
step_3_rule_out_black_cleaver_as_the_cau.cached_item_values: Black Cleaver (id 3071) 'Carve': 5 stacks max, 6% armor reduction per stack, 30% at 5 stacks.
step_3_rule_out_black_cleaver_as_the_cau.damage_ratio_identity: post = raw x 100/(100+R) (docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 2.1), so ratio_new/old = (100 + A(1 - 0.06 s_old)) / (100 + A(1 - 0.06 s_new)) for base armor A

numeric_sweep.hard_ceiling: Even the impossible extreme s_old=4 -> s_new=5 (full 30% shred) tops out at 0.76/0.70 = 1.0857 only as A->inf; it equals 1.0808 only at A = 2000 armor, and gives just 1.0353 at A = 100.

step_3_rule_out_black_cleaver_as_the_cau.verdict: A Black Cleaver stack-model change CANNOT produce a 1.0808 ratio at any realistic armor. Ruled out as the cause of this leaf's move.

step_4_identify_the_mechanism.mechanism: Bloodsong (id 3877) 'Spellblade' -> 'Expose Weakness': an 8% (melee holder) / 5% (ranged holder) increased-damage-taken debuff on the target, explicitly 'from all sources', 4 s duration, 1.5 s cooldown.
step_4_identify_the_mechanism.why_it_applies_to_this_event: The debuff is a target-side amplifier, not a holder-side one ('take X% increased damage from all sources'), so in a coupled ROSTER fight it must amplify every participant's damage on that target, not just the Bloodsong holder's. With a 4 s duration refreshed on a 1.5 s cooldown, uptime is continuous after the first empowered attack, so an event as deep in the ledger as index 48 sits inside the window.
step_4_identify_the_mechanism.composition_rule: data/wiki-atoms/damage.json, atom damage.modifier: 'percentage damage amplification ... percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.' So the amp is a clean multiplicative x1.08 on the post-mitigation number - exactly the shape of the observed move.
step_4_identify_the_mechanism.rd_template_decoded: {{rd|X|Y}} = melee value | ranged value, corroborated across the cache: Ravenous Hydra {{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}, Titanic Hydra {{rd|1%|0.5%}}, Blade of the Ruined King {{rd|9%|6%}}, Phage {{rd|20|10}}, Hullbreaker {{rd|120%|120*0.7%}}. Hence Bloodsong = 8% melee / 5% ranged.
step_4_identify_the_mechanism.independent_value: 101.7 (= old x 1.08, to the stored 0.1 precision)

step_5_alternatives_considered.press_the_attack: data/runes.json 'Press the Attack' also carries an 8% damage amplifier. It is numerically indistinguishable from the Bloodsong branch here (both are x1.08) and does not change the verdict; the scenario id names Bloodsong, which is the amp actually under test.
step_5_alternatives_considered.crit_or_stat_drift: A crit-expectation or stat change could in principle yield 1.08, but nothing in the cached data pins such a change to a Cleaver+Bloodsong roster scenario, and no other cached percentage lands in the band.
step_5_alternatives_considered.old_value_correct_branch: Old would be right only if Expose Weakness were absent/expired at event 48. The cached text ('from all sources', 4 s, 1.5 s cooldown) gives near-100% uptime mid-fight, and the old value corresponds to NO amp at all rather than to the ranged 5% branch - so 94.1 cannot be the sourced number under either melee or ranged reading.
step_5_alternatives_considered.both_wrong_branch: If the Bloodsong holder in this roster were RANGED, the sourced value would be 94.1 x 1.05 = 98.8 and both stored values would be wrong. The roster composition is not recoverable from the permitted evidence tree; the melee branch is the one consistent with a Black Cleaver (melee-bruiser) pairing, and it is the branch the new value instantiates. Residual risk is confined to that melee/ranged flag.

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.

Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8*max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch). Under the engine's own ordering convention ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C

Ravenous Hydra: 'Basic attacks [[on-hit]] deal {{as|{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}|ad}}'; Blade of the Ruined King: '{{rd|9%|6%}} of the target's current health'; Phage: '{{rd|20|10}} bonus movement speed' - first slot melee, second slot ranged.
The third stack consumes all stacks to deal ... bonus adaptive damage and grant you 8% increased damage against champions until 5 seconds after exiting combat with them.

independent_result.formula: damage = (raw x 100/(100 + R_post_pen)) x 1.08,  where 1.08 is Bloodsong 'Expose Weakness' (melee branch of {{rd|8%|5%}}) applied multiplicatively per damage.modifier

caveats: The scenario definition is not in the permitted evidence tree, so this is a ratio-level oracle rather than an absolute end-to-end recomputation of event[48] from champion base stats.

The verdict depends on the Bloodsong holder being MELEE (8%). A ranged holder would make the sourced value 98.8 and the verdict 'both_wrong'. Nothing under data/ names the roster, but the Black Cleaver pairing in the scenario id points to a melee holder.
